name: LocodeDetails
description:
City or logistics location information returned when the timezone
lookup is performed using a UN/LOCODE.

UN/LOCODE is a five-character identifier consisting of a two-letter
country code followed by a three-character location identifier.

lo_code.description: UN/LOCODE representing the city or logistics location.

city.description: Name of the city associated with the UN/LOCODE.

state_code.description: State or region code of the location.

country_name.description: Name of the country where the location exists.

location_type.description:
Type of facilities available at the location such as port,
rail terminal, road terminal, airport, or postal exchange.
location_type.example: Port, Rail Terminal, Road Terminal, Airport, Postal Exchange
